approach: The root-cause fix is already in the base. That is the documented split on JobRecords::invocations (store.rs:29-33), Records::all_invocations (store.rs:524), RoleNeed::compute reading only that source (role_need.rs:82-125), the system fact, and known-active replay tests. This job closes the gaps that let the class reopen, and stays inside the brief's deliverable files (nothing in athena-data changes). (1) A test-only complete role list, `ALL_ROLES: [Role; 8]`, sits in store.rs under `#[cfg(test)]`. A completeness test reads the `Role` enum source and fails if a variant is missing from the list. (2) The store `from_parts` coverage test loops over `ALL_ROLES` instead of its hand-written array. (3) `MEASURED_ROLES` is hoisted to a const in role_need.rs; `compute` uses it, and a classification test requires every role to be measured or on demand, never both and never neither. (4) New test `every_role_loaded_through_from_parts_is_counted_and_classified` in role_need.rs. It builds records through the real `Records::from_parts` routing, with one Invocation record per `ALL_ROLES` entry in each of 10 closed jobs, and asserts on the output of `RoleNeed::compute`. Every role appears in `roles` with count > 0. Steward, audience and auditor are in `not_measured` with source SOURCE_OUTSIDE_JOBS and unflagged. None of the three is a retire candidate. The assertions are in this diff and fail if `compute` reads `job.invocations`. (5) A separate CHANGELOG bullet. Producer first greps criteria 1, 2, 5, 6 against the working copy and edits docs, spec.toml, status.rs, display.rs, lib.rs, shard-timings.txt and the CLI test only where a grep shows a gap. No refusal rule is added, so no refusal corpus case or refused-share number applies.

decisions.choice: Keep all edits to the listed deliverable files. Put the complete role list as `#[cfg(test)] pub(crate) const ALL_ROLES: [Role; 8]` in crates/athena-core/src/store.rs, with a completeness test that scans the `pub enum Role {` body (athena-data/src/records.rs:21-32) read with `include_str!("../../athena-data/src/records.rs")`. Each variant name, lower-cased, must pass `Role::parse` and appear in `ALL_ROLES`, and the variant count must equal `ALL_ROLES.len()`.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 1: athena-data/records.rs is not changed. Answers finding 4: no second hand-kept index or ordering. The test needs only membership and count. A new variant already fails to compile at `Role::as_str` (records.rs:35-45), so the compile-time push exists. The list can be silently incomplete, though, and the enum-source scan is what catches that. Cross-crate `include_str!` paths are already used in tests (refusal_corpus.rs:1138).

rejected.why: Outside the brief's deliverable list (finding 1). The test-only list plus the enum-source scan gives the same guard inside the deliverables.

decisions.choice: Drop the proposed text scan of the `Records` struct (`unchained_invocation_lists`). The `from_parts` routing test over `ALL_ROLES` is the guard for a fourth list.

A substring scan of field names would pass wrongly when one name is contained in another (`runs` inside `auditor_runs`). Dropping it removes a weak and brittle check.

decisions.choice: Add a role_need test, driven by `ALL_ROLES` and loaded through `Records::from_parts`, that asserts the output of `RoleNeed::compute` for every role. It does not inspect internals.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 2: the diff carries the steward, audience and auditor outcome assertions (count > 0, source SOURCE_OUTSIDE_JOBS, in not_measured, not flagged, absent from retire_candidates). It fails on a `compute` that reads `job.invocations`, because those runs are in no job list. It also fails on a role left unrouted or unchained, because that role's count is 0. This covers the cause rather than one fixed role list.

In the store.rs test module, add `all_roles_lists_every_role_variant`. It cuts `include_str!("../../athena-data/src/records.rs")` at `pub enum Role {` up to the first line that is exactly `}`, skips `///` and `#[` lines, and takes variants of the form `<Ident>,`. It asserts at least 8 were found and equals `ALL_ROLES.len()`. For each variant it asserts `Role::parse(&name.to_lowercase())` is `Some(r)` with `ALL_ROLES.contains(&r)`, and it asserts that `ALL_ROLES` has no duplicates. Rewrite `all_invocations_covers_every_loaded_invocation` (l.713-765) to build `roles` from `ALL_ROLES`.

In role_need.rs, add `pub const MEASURED_ROLES: &[Role] = &[Role::Reader, Role::Planner, Role::Critic, Role::Producer, Role::Verifier];` with a doc comment that avoids the words forbidden by the l.577 scan. Replace the local `all_roles` array (l.127-133) in `compute` with `MEASURED_ROLES` (same order, so `for role in MEASURED_ROLES.iter().copied()`).

In the role_need.rs test module, move the RecordFile-building code from `runs_kept_outside_job_records_are_counted_with_their_source_and_not_flagged` (l.433-479) into a helper `through_from_parts(records: &Records) -> Records`, and keep that test passing. Add `every_role_is_measured_or_on_demand`: for each role in `crate::store::ALL_ROLES`, assert it is in exactly one of `MEASURED_ROLES` and `ON_DEMAND_ROLES`.

In the role_need.rs test module, add `every_role_loaded_through_from_parts_is_counted_and_classified`. Build 10 jobs with states from `known_active`'s list. For each job and each role in `ALL_ROLES`, make an Invocation (distinct seq per role, `started_at` = `at(n)`) as an `AnyRecord::Invocation`, plus one Outcome per job. Load through `through_from_parts` (the real `Records::from_parts`). Call `RoleNeed::compute`. Assert: each `ALL_ROLES` role has a `need.roles` entry with count > 0; "steward", "audience" and "auditor" have source SOURCE_OUTSIDE_JOBS, are unflagged, are in `not_measured`, and are not in `retire_candidates`; `retire_candidates` is empty. Make sure the job-role invocations are under jobs that are in the window and that no job has a duplicate canonical path.

Confirm the new tests are not vacuous. Temporarily change one `all_invocations()` read in `compute` to a read of the job lists, run `cargo test -p athena-core role_need`, see the new tests fail, then restore. Report the result.

In CHANGELOG.md, add a separate bullet under Unreleased/Added. It names the root cause: invocations are kept in four places and nothing guarded the list of sources or the list of roles. It says the fix landed in 41539a7 and b670592. It names `ALL_ROLES` (test-only), `MEASURED_ROLES` and the output test. Use no personal names, machine names or email text.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core store`, `cargo test -p athena-core role_need` and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test status_role_need`. Then run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`, and fix any failure.

risks.risk: The enum-source scan in `all_roles_lists_every_role_variant` is brittle to formatting, and to a future multi-word variant, which would lower-case to a name `Role::parse` does not know.
risks.mitigation: It cuts at `pub enum Role {` up to the first line that is exactly `}`, skips `///` and `#[` lines, and takes each variant as `<Ident>,`. It asserts the variant count is at least 8, so an empty scan fails loudly. A failure on a multi-word variant tells the author to update the test and `ALL_ROLES`.

risks.risk: A fourth list that is not keyed by a new Role (for example routing an existing role by a condition) is not caught by the role-driven from_parts test.
risks.mitigation: `from_parts` routes by role only today (store.rs:429-437). The doc comments on `JobRecords::invocations` and `Records::all_invocations` name the split, and role_need.rs:577 forbids direct reads. This is a limit the plan names, not a hidden one.

risks.risk: The base already holds the root-cause fix, so the new tests do not show the old blind-measure failure through a pre-change checkout. On pre-change code they fail by not compiling.
risks.mitigation: The outcome assertions in the new output test fail on any `compute` that reads `job.invocations`. The producer can confirm this by temporarily switching one read in a scratch run, and reports the result. The CHANGELOG bullet states that the fix landed in 41539a7 and b670592.

risks.risk: No replay over real `records/` is possible: the snapshot has none (producer snapshot, system facts).
risks.mitigation: Fixtures use the real routing through `Records::from_parts`, and status_role_need.rs goes through the real `athena status` path. The measure only advises and this plan changes no counts or order, so no expected range from real records applies.

risks.risk: The producer duplicates work already in the base, or edits files that need no change.
risks.mitigation: Step 1 is a Grep of each content criterion against the working copy. The six no-change deliverables are edited only if a Grep shows a gap.
